name: PantryPal
one_liner: Snap a photo of your fridge to get three recipes you can cook right now.
problem: Figuring out what to cook with whatever ingredients are left in the fridge is difficult and often leads to wasted food.
audience: Home cooks looking to prepare meals using ingredients they already have on hand.

features.name: Ingredient detection from fridge photo
features.description: Users take a photo of their open fridge with the camera to automatically identify visible ingredients.

features.name: Ranked recipe suggestions
features.description: Users receive three recipe suggestions ranked by how many of their available ingredients they use.

features.name: Missing ingredients shopping list
features.description: Users view a shopping list containing the missing items required to make the suggested recipes.
